children: Game Your Game entered a Support Services Agreement with Grafiti effective September 1, 2026, to obtain advisory, accounting, tax, and administrative support. The deal includes a $117,500 upfront payment for Sept–Dec 2026 and a $20,000 monthly fee from Jan 1 to Sep 1, 2027, with annual renewals possible. Bonus compensation of $25,000 to $1.5 million may be paid, in cash or stock, for transactions resulting directly from the services. The one-year term auto-renews; the company can terminate for cause anytime and on 30 days' notice after Sep 1, 2027.
: Access advisory, accounting, tax, and administrative support services
